gotchas.title: Richardson fee schedule is not a fixed number — recheck before bid
checklist: Pull current Richardson Building / Development Services fee schedule
Do not invent dollar amounts from memory or sister-city sheets
Stamp contingency only after schedule confirm
anti_patterns: Copying Plano/Dallas fee lines into a Richardson bid

gotchas.title: Do not use sister-city fees for Richardson
checklist: Confirm trade fees on Richardson official schedule only
Document which schedule PDF/page was used in the bid file
anti_patterns: Assuming DFW metros share the same electrical permit fee

gotchas.title: Large-load / data center: AHJ + utility parallel clocks
checklist: Treat utility interconnection as parallel to Richardson permits
Build contingency for both municipal and utility timelines
Confirm zoning/use path early for mission-critical load
anti_patterns: Assuming city permit alone clears large-load path

gotchas.title: Confirm trade application type early
checklist: Electrical vs general building vs multi-trade path — confirm with AHJ
Wrong application type stalls plan review
anti_patterns: Assuming one permit path covers all trades

gotchas.title: Richardson rough → service → final sequence
checklist: Confirm service/meter equipment inspection when applicable
Hold final until AHJ checklist items are closed
anti_patterns: Skipping rough and hoping final covers it
